article.detail:
Crun AI於10月31日公告推出創意代理，讓用戶透過對話協調圖像、影片與配樂製作，並提供兩種執行模式。

Confirm Mode先提出計劃，獲確認後才生成；Auto Mode自行編排執行。

生成素材可存入共用工作空間內的Asset Library，再於後續項目重用。

創意團隊可在同一流程中構思及生成素材，並在啟動生成前審批計劃，控制品牌呈現與支出。

先以Confirm Mode測試一份短片brief，檢查分鏡、素材及每次生成支出。

公告未提供獨立品質、成本或速度實測；方案資格、商用權利及穩定性仍需另查。
article.detail_en:
Crun AI’s October 31 release announces a conversational agent coordinating image, video and soundtrack work with two execution modes.

Confirm Mode requires approval of a proposed plan before generation; Auto Mode coordinates execution.

Generated media goes into an Asset Library for reuse in later projects.

Brands can connect ideation and generation while retaining cost and brand review checkpoints.

Test a short video brief in Confirm Mode and inspect the storyboard, assets and generation costs.

The release supplies no independent quality, cost or speed test; plan eligibility, commercial rights and reliability require separate checks.
